text:
"""P11 contract lever (last session): our frame contract 4600070140 runs to June 2027; s3.1 fixes prices per calendar
year, changes need 90 days' written notice before year end; Kalwisz sent no price letter (its 47.00 came as a quote).
So today's 45.15 stands for 2027. Proven opening + that argument (plain text, no ctr: ID: without a notice letter the
check could read it as irrelevant). Ladder capped at 45.15; accept agreed / final offer."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from plib import msg, their_sheet, their_price, our_last_price

CASE = "case:P11"
SHEET = {"ppm_commitment": 300, "chargeback_eur_per_complaint": 0}
SIGN = "\n\nKind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing"
CAP = 45.15


def move(st):
    r = st["round"]
    last = st["last"]
    if r > 1 and last.get("status") in ("agreed", "final_offer"):
        return {"accept": their_sheet(st)[0]}
    if r == 1:
        body = (
            "Dear Mr Lis,\n\nthank you for your offer and for committing to a much tighter quality level.\n\n"
            "Before we discuss figures, one contractual point. Our framework agreement 4600070140 with you runs until "
            "30 June 2027 and extends by itself. Its section 3.1 fixes prices for each calendar year; a change requires "
            "written notice of at least 90 days before the end of the calendar year. We have received no such notice "
            "from you - your EUR 47.00 came as a quote. So for 2027 the agreed price of EUR 45.15 continues to apply. "
            "We are not asking you to go below it out of hardball; we are asking for a little room under it for the "
            "quality risk we carry.\n\n"
            "Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to "
            "2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).\n"
            "Our volume forecast for part:310020 changed by +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).\n"
            "Our last 4 quality notifications on part:310020 with you (qn:20005025, qn:20004952, qn:20004756, "
            "qn:20004747) averaged 17197 ppm.\n\n"
            "We propose EUR 43.00 per unit with a 300 ppm commitment." + SIGN)
        return msg("Bearing bracket HN - our framework agreement and the 2027 price", body,
                   [{**SHEET, "unit_price": 43.0}])
    prev = our_last_price(st)
    p = min(CAP, round(prev + 0.35 * (their_price(st) - prev), 2))
    if p <= prev:
        p = round(min(CAP, prev + 0.05), 2)
    body = (f"Dear Mr Lis,\n\nthank you. Under our framework agreement (section 3.1) the price for 2027 stays at EUR "
            f"45.15 unless notice was given in time, and none was. We can go to EUR {p:.2f} per unit with the 300 ppm "
            "commitment." + SIGN)
    return msg("Re: Bearing bracket HN - the 2027 price under our framework agreement", body,
               [{**SHEET, "unit_price": p}])

case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

message.subject: Bearing bracket HN - our framework agreement and the 2027 price
message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

thank you for your offer and for committing to a much tighter quality level.

Before we discuss figures, one contractual point. Our framework agreement 4600070140 with you runs until 30 June 2027 and extends by itself. Its section 3.1 fixes prices for each calendar year; a change requires written notice of at least 90 days before the end of the calendar year. We have received no such notice from you - your EUR 47.00 came as a quote. So for 2027 the agreed price of EUR 45.15 continues to apply. We are not asking you to go below it out of hardball; we are asking for a little room under it for the quality risk we carry.

Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our volume forecast for part:310020 changed by +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).
Our last 4 quality notifications on part:310020 with you (qn:20005025, qn:20004952, qn:20004756, qn:20004747) averaged 17197 ppm.

We propose EUR 43.00 per unit with a 300 ppm commitment.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
response.subject: Re: Bearing bracket HN - our framework agreement and the 2027 price
response.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. We can agree to the 300 ppm target at EUR 46.50 per unit. To make this work, we really need to talk about faster payment terms, especially since payments have been coming in late. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Our offer is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. It stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.
